default.notes: A visa is required — apply for the official eVisa on voyage.gouv.tg before travel, or obtain a 7-day visa on arrival at Lomé airport (about 25,000 CFA francs, cash) and extend it at the immigration service in Lomé if needed.

groups.notes: ECOWAS citizens enter Togo without a visa under the community's free-movement protocol — up to 90 days with a passport or ECOWAS travel document.

TG.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Togolese citizens.
